name: sg_template_version_create
description: Create a new version of a transactional template. A version is the body/subject content of a template; only one version per template can be active. (POST /v3/templates/{template_id}/versions)

template_id.description: The ID of the transactional template for which the new version is created.

name.description: Name of the transactional template version. Max length 100 characters.

subject.description: Subject of the new transactional template version. Max length 255 characters.

html_content.description: The HTML content of the version. Maximum of 1048576 bytes allowed.

plain_content.description: Text/plain content of the transactional template version. Maximum of 1048576 bytes allowed.

active.description: Set the version as the active version associated with the template (0 is inactive, 1 is active). Only one version of a template can be active.

editor.description: The editor used in the UI: code or design.
